root_idea.summary: The root centers on joining or leaning one thing against another, whether physically, relationally, or by attribution.
root_idea.development: From the basic notion of one thing resting upon or being joined to another develop meanings of support, reliance, ascent along a rising surface, attribution to an authority, and collective alignment under separate standards.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic passive participial adjective is presented under its normalized masculine singular citation form.

senses.definition: Propped up; set leaning against a support.
senses.usage_conditions: In خُشُبٌ مُسَنَّدَةٌ, the passive participle describes pieces of wood set up or made to lean as supports. The feminine singular form reflects agreement with the nonhuman broken plural خُشُبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lean, rest, or stay against or upon something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I intransitive usage; the object may be a thing, wall, or other support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ascend a mountain or rise along an elevated surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I usage, also extended to ascending to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach or draw near to a stated age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction سَنَدَ فِي الخَمْسِينَ or سَنَدَ لِلْخَمْسِينَ, ‘he approached fifty.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel’s tail, to toss about and lash her rump from side to side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the movement of the tail.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wear or clothe oneself with a garment called سَنَد.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II usage referring to a type of burd garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To support or stay another, so that one part or person strengthens another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal or relational construction may describe one part of a thing supporting another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To aid or assist another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III transitive usage with a person as the one assisted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To requite, compensate, or recompense someone for work or an act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested with عَلَى العَمَلِ, ‘for the work.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to have a firm, prominent, or proportionately arranged frame.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The descriptions concern the relation and prominence of the parts of the body; the cited explanations include both symmetrical and differing structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a person or thing lean, rest, or stay against or upon something; to prop or support it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative usage, including making a leaning thing stable or supported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rest or place one’s affair upon someone as a support or reliance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV construction with an affair or matter made dependent upon a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Attribution of a tradition to its authority; a tradition traced or ascribed to its transmitter or ultimate author.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In technical hadith usage, the attribution may be expressed by naming the transmitting chain, ordinarily up to the Prophet; مُسْنَدٌ can describe a tradition so traced.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In logic, assigning or judging one thing to stand in an affirmative or negative attribute relation to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional technical use concerning the relation of an attribute to its subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A figurative attribution of an act, quality, or meaning to something other than its literal bearer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rhetorical and lexicological term for tropical attribution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assign a verb or predication to its grammatical subject, object, or associated agents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical construction; the assigned relation can concern a subject, an object, or multiple agents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone ascend a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV causative counterpart to the intransitive ascent usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exert oneself vigorously in running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form IV usage referring to effort and intensity in running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, to move at a pace between two specified gaits.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of camel locomotion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go forth in separate groups under different commanders or banners.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The groups are not all under one commander or standard; each party proceeds under its own banner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mutually aiding or supporting one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of people, including two persons going forth together, each relying on and assisting the other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sind: a country or the people belonging to it; also the name of the Indus River and of several places called al-Sind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may refer collectively to the nation, to an individual person from it, or geographically to the river, district, or town.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rising face, acclivity, or elevated portion of a mountain, valley, or ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Specifically the part that faces the observer and rises from the base or foot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing against or upon which one leans or rests, such as a wall, cushion, or pillow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for a physical support; its plural is مَسَانِدُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who serves as a stay, support, or object of reliance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use for a trusted person or chief upon whom others depend.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A type of cloth or garment, especially a garment of the burd fabrics.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also describe layered clothing in which one shirt is worn beneath another; plural usage varies by source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An anvil used by a blacksmith.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized tool noun, synonymous with عَلَاة or زُبْرَة in the cited explanations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Great and strong.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied adjectivally to a man or a wolf.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-ass, domestic or wild.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited source associates the term with strength, but that association is not required in the definition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The ilex or evergreen oak, a kind of tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tree name in later usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, strong or strong-built; variously described as tall-humped, long-legged and elevated in the hump, or lean and lank in the belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexicographical explanations differ, and one authority rejects the lean-and-lank interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More explicit or firmly stated with respect to a tradition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative epithet used with لِلْحَدِيثِ and explained by أَنَصُّ لَهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A narration or act of transmitting a report.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized usage with the plural أَسَانِيدُ, distinct from the technical chain or attribution itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The identification is reported separately from the commonly known name سِنْدِيَانٌ, with a source note questioning whether the latter identification is a mistake.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or object on, or against, which one leans or rests; hence a couch or throne.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for a supporting place or furnishing; plural مَسَانِدُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made to lean or rest against something; stayed, propped, or supported.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Passive participle of Form IV, with a related substantive use for a thing set up as a support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who claims as his father someone who is not his father; an adopted or suspected-lineage person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative lexical use opposed to كَرِيمٌ in the cited contrast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A technical term for one of the two members of a proposition involved in an attribution relation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Authorities differ over whether مُسْنَدٌ denotes the subject or the predicate; مُسْنَدٌ إِلَيْهِ denotes the corresponding term to which the attribution is made.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Himyaritic or Himyeritic script and character of writing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term refers to the distinct writing system used in Yemen and associated with Himyeritic language or inscriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Time, especially the whole duration of time or an indefinitely long time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used idiomatically for the end of time or for ‘ever.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain kind of cloth or garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal Form II passive-participial form used for this garment type independently of the Quranic adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, having a prominent, firm, or strongly formed breast, forepart, withers, or back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources give several explanations, including firm compactness and symmetry or asymmetry of the frame; the term is specialized to camel description.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The Form II causative of setting wood as stays is covered by the Quranic passive result-state.
